name: Lovable
summary: Build full-stack web apps by chatting with AI.
description: Lovable is an AI app builder that creates and edits full-stack web applications from natural-language prompts. Users iterate in a chat interface, connect a backend, and deploy without writing code by hand, which makes it popular with founders and non-developers prototyping products. It offers a free plan to get started and paid plans with more messages and collaboration features.
